title: Streamlit for AI Dashboards
summary: In this beginner-friendly session from the Austin AI Middleware Users Group (AIMUG) September Showcase, Jeff Linwood demonstrates how to quickly build interactive dashboards using Streamlit, integrate LangChain, and chat with your data.
